title: Five at the Teeth

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The reed gives its last third to the water and keeps the count in the arm that carried it, and the arm does not know the figure. Hold a word five times at the teeth and it is a held word still; keep a tally where no thumb can read it and no Court will enter it.
epigraph.attribution: A proverb of Low Kiln, said over the banked fire

where: Low Kiln, the Weir and Sill
pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a one-hundred-and-thirty-five-to-one-hundred-and-thirty-seven-day-old body carried everywhere; the surgeon's register colours the noticing (the carrying arm as a record in muscle that tells what was carried and not what it cost, the finger beneath the board as a second account kept where nobody thinks to look, a sentence stopped at the word as an object on the interval tray, the cold foot read exactly and worth nothing) without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line --- the old life stays offstage --- and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room, back-room interior, Ulda on stage, Fenna named in narration, a fifth green at a mouth, present-tense break or ending

scenes.title: The Last Third
scenes.synopsis: First entry and first dated heading of Day 135, Reed 16, Sixthday, morning going into midday at the Clay Yard and the reed beds below Low Kiln. The reed month goes into its last third; the bundles come in armfuls judged by the arm that carries them and by nothing set on a slate, and a woman at the racks asks what the cutters' hands will be paid and is answered with the weather and the river, never a figure (T071/T072, T077, T058/T079). The yard goes around the clean dark line where the Ash ridge turned, the new finer grey called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie, and the empty place in the returning line where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out --- a look, a wide step, no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, not paid). The boy, one hundred and thirty-five days old and four months and fifteen days, reads the carrying arm as a record in muscle that tells what was carried and not what it cost, exact and worth nothing, and his hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the note of water and comes down. Advances T071/T072 (135 kept exact), T077, T058/T079, T009/T013/T092, T098, T060/T086. Withheld: no figure for the hands or the reeds, no name, cause, body or count for the missing hand, no joining of the empty places.

scenes.title: The Jar and the Board
scenes.synopsis: Second entry continued, Day 135, midday into the afternoon under the Vail kiln-house roof at the loaf shelf and the hearth. Sella Vail sets the basket low and a little back near the bench leg at the angle at which the underside of a board becomes a roof, gives the instruction to the wool, the pot, the broom and the fire and never to the basket, and tells the fire it was the thaw (T058/T079). The row keeps its two unnamed gaps, the old space at the row's end and the palm's breadth that came in on the night of Seed 6 with no scrape, crumb, print or word, in a room the fold does not touch (T060/T086, T097 carried and unpaid). Standing with her back to the basket, she glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and gives no figure, then reaches a finger BENEATH the board where the charcoal tally lies without looking and without a word and brings it away; the boy sees the hand go under and come back and sees nothing of what the marks say, and makes no cause of the habit (T100 carried, not paid, unread). A neighbour with a wet pot asks what the row will want before the tend is out and is sent to the pot with the house has said it (T077, T058/T079). The widow's mark hangs untouched because a shelf and an afternoon are not openings. Advances T100 (carried), T060/T086, T097, T058/T079, T077. Withheld hard: no stroke counted, no figure read, no copying hand, no joining of the charcoal to the two gaps above or the one crust in the fold.

scenes.title: Dust Ahead of the Sentence
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and first dated heading of Day 136, Reed 17, Seventhday, before first grey through midday at the Vail wheel-shed, its finger's-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper and the Clay Yard. Three or four unnamed men come up with their collars high and speak low in the room off the shed; Sella carries the boy past at the half-pace, gives the house no name for the men and does not say the room was cold (T035/T031). Jorra Vail comes through with fine grey slate dust ground small as meal into both forearms past the bent little finger, not bone-coloured slip, keeps dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray and asks neither which slate was broken nor whether it was a birth-slate. He speaks to the wheel before anyone (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), tells a pot You'll do, knows its full note before it leaves the wheel and withholds the knowing from a High Kiln kiln-master who would call it early and make something of it (T035/T031/T062). Before Sella has finished telling him the fire is low his bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and leaves it standing; the boy reads the iron again as the bite that holds a vessel whole and the bite that can take the hand off a man, with no Grathic word for both mercies, and files it as an object joined to no kiln (T062). The two tellings of the shut counting room stay beside the iron with no third (T065/T095). Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed and wants the late thaw because it puts off the paying; his seventh year is pressed nearer its end and still held, the knife at the very edge of its sill with six counted where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot, the breath from Seed 16 unspent (T036/T076). Advances T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T036/T076, T058/T079. Withheld: no naming of the men, no entry of the room, no third telling, no calling word or payment.

scenes.title: The Fifth Stopping
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry continued, Day 136, late afternoon at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge and the going of the light into the small hours at the hearth and kindling under the Vail roof. The soft-cuffed clerk is still set at the landing for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and grey again by midday, slate to his forearm and hand to slate before eyes to stalls; the market sells its reeds and eels over the top of him, nobody steps around him and nobody takes him off (T090/T080/T083). At the hearth, with coals banked and the small knife set back where it can be checked, Tarn tells the kindling Six counted. The next I don't count, and then the sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it comes a FIFTH time all the way to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name (T036/T076). He draws the breath that should go in at the top of the reach and does not spend it, says Yes, house to the fire and goes on with the broom. Sella, within hearing, gives the end of her instruction to the pot and asks nothing; Jorra does not ask about the ear and Tarn does not ask about the room, and the two silences stay unjoined. The chapter's one meaningful change: the boy files the fifth stopping on the interval tray beside the first four as a FIFTH INTERVAL AND NOT A FIFTH PAYMENT, an object among objects and not a rule, not a hearing and not a seventh, refusing to let five likenesses stand up and call themselves a doctrine --- for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer (T036/T076, T061/T082). The carried fire keeps its four low pulls and its silent fifth with its payer unnamed for a hundred and thirty-six days (T088). Advances T036/T076 (fifth stopping withheld), T061/T082, T090/T080/T083, T088, T058/T079. Withheld: no calling word spoken, no figure, no name, no payment, no seventh hearing, and the seventh year still not given.

scenes.title: The Knot Inside the Coat
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and first dated heading of Day 137, Reed 18, Eighthday, morning downriver at the Weir, the plank walk on posts and the flat blessing stone. The reed work goes on in armfuls judged by the arm that carries them (T071/T072). The reed-cutter comes along the boards with a bundle and the short length of grey wool or reed-fibre cord gone grey with the oil of a working thumb; he sets the bundle on the flat stone, straightens the cord, turns it once so the knots stand in the small light, ties one low with his teeth and a pull of the thumb, bites the end off and puts it back inside his coat. To the woman who asks what it holds he says You can ask the cord and No more can the Court; no figure, knot, name or joining (T099 carried, not paid). Orra Weir stands at the lower boards with her board on its side and pulls one knot down with her thumb, giving a date where a levy question was asked and keeping the word forty unspoken with the forty-first double turn legible and unnamed (T024/T059/T025). Mira Silt works the eels with pale slime dried in grey strokes and silt in the hollow of her neck, answers a thin run with her own answer, flicks eel-bones while deciding whether to lie and puts her thumb under her apron to the grey cord when a buyer names a figure; the second cord twisted twice beneath it stays unread, never carried upriver to Nine Pots or lifted at a door, her board beside Orra's and not touching (T059/T025/T024). Advances T099, T024/T059/T025, T071/T072, T058/T079. Withheld: no knot counted, no figure read, no word forty, no joining of the cord to the missing hand or to any other private record.

scenes.title: Two Marks Short and a Dark Foot
scenes.synopsis: Sixth entry continued, Day 137, midday at the Cross and the market stalls, then below the sill at the fish-trade shade. Berr Clay comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded under his coat and the green of tasted glaze at one corner of his mouth; he wipes his thumb twice before touching nothing, holds a narrow slate unopened to his forearm and passes a finger over the figure, buys eels two marks short and says a number goes into a slate, not a bundle, taking himself out of his own sentence with your house, never I, while the stall-keeper puts the marks in her palm without counting them aloud (T015/T041/T047). The green stays at his own mouth on a place of its own; no fifth green at a silent woman's mouth is glimpsed this chapter and none of the colours is named or joined to an ear (T050/T051 held). Below the sill a child's foot stays dark inside three turns of wool, the cold to the woman who wrapped it and weather to the yard; the surgeon's reading of the extremity going before the core and the afterdrop waiting on the far side of a warming he cannot perform works and buys nothing, and no silt-leach, cause, cure or recognition is written across it (T093/T094/T096). Mira's second twist stays twice beneath the grey with neither knot counted and her board beside Orra's without touching (T059/T025/T024). The soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the landing for a measure nobody called (T090/T080). Advances T015/T041/T047, T093/T094/T096, T059/T025/T024, T090/T080, T050/T051 (held, not gathered). Withheld: no fifth green at a mouth, no Fenna in narration, no name from Dessa, no silt-leach or cure, no knot counted, no word forty.

scenes.title: One Hundred and Thirty-Seven
scenes.synopsis: Seventh entry continued, Day 137, the going of the light and the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof at the loaf shelf and on the bed. Sella carries the boy up the clay road at the half-pace from every open slate, goes around the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie as wide as a pail of hot water set where a child might knock it, sets him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without looking at his face, leaves the thread of drool frozen and unwiped, her hand resting a half-beat longer than the setting before it goes away; she tells the fire it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the wrist that carries the little-door burn, sets the pot rim out and handle toward the reaching hand with the handle two inches beyond the hand that will not close on it, and does not look toward the bed or touch the widow's mark because a dusk is not an opening (T058/T079). He turns out his file as a man lays instruments on a towel and finds every object in its place and nothing laid across anything else: six hearings of the full note beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and not paid, the interval tray with FIVE stoppings as objects and not a rule, the damper's double bite filed joined to no kiln, the two shut-room tellings with no third, one crust in the fold with its empty place unnamed and no third, the shelf's two gaps in a room that does not touch, the charcoal under the shelf on a place of its own and unread, the word forty unspoken with the readable double turn beside it, the cold foot still the cold to one woman and weather to the yard, Alda's six pages and both tins and Dessa's pewter tin shut, the clerk still set, the loan uncalled and the seventh year still held (T061/T082, T036/T076, T060/T086, T100, T097, T098, T099, T093/T096). Through the finger's-width door came the river's note of water over water, a fifth low thing never counted among the full note; through the floor under blind ash the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer unnamed for a hundred and thirty-seven days; overhead the boards keep four nails, four, and a fifth that is a knot the width of a thumb --- three counts in three places that do not become one (T088, T071/T072). One hundred and thirty-seven days old, four months and seventeen days, he is told by nobody; his hand goes up an inch toward the note of water and comes down, the count exact, unspent and forward. Advances T071/T072 (137 kept exact), T058/T079, T061/T082, T036/T076, T060/T086, T100, T097, T098, T099, T088. Withheld: nothing joined, paid, named, opened, called or ended; no seventh hearing, no sixth sighting, no sale.
